limitations: Final real Codex connection failed in one case; another delegated evaluation ended without a reliable receipt. An earlier isolated failure explicitly reported network stream disconnection. Not every current generic native failure has a confirmed root cause.
Pi compatibility covers declared isolated tool APIs and supported hooks, not the entire Node/UI/provider/durable SDK ABI.
Programmatic calls currently combine governed reads. Mutations and delegation use ordinary governed actions and work plans.
Native LSP currently supports TypeScript/JavaScript and JSX; its Windows Job Object provides process ownership/stop evidence rather than filesystem isolation.
Automation is finite elapsed-interval scheduling rather than a general cron engine. Session retrieval is literal bounded SQL rather than Hermes FTS5 ranking.
Short-term unseen-input and recovery tests do not prove months of generalization or equal-model performance parity with the four upstream products.
